Extreme close-up: extreme close-up framing tight on eyes and upper face, short-telephoto compression, pores and micro-detail visible, almost abstract intimacy
Close-up: close-up portrait framing head and shoulders, short-telephoto look, sharp facial detail, soft background separation
Medium close-up: medium close-up from chest up, classic portrait lens perspective, clear expression and upper-body gesture, balanced headroom
Medium shot: medium shot waist-up, standard lens perspective, readable pose and wardrobe, natural conversational distance
Medium wide: medium-wide shot including most of the body and nearby environment, mild wide environmental context, room to show stance and setting
Wide shot: wide shot full figure in environment, wider environmental perspective, clear spatial relationship between subject and setting
Full body: full-body framing head to toe with intentional margin, full-figure environmental perspective, silhouette and outfit fully readable
